en: The front of the postcard features two colorized images. The left image shows a decorative wellhouse in a wooded area labeled 'Helenenquelle,' likely a historical mineral spring or fountain. The right image depicts a three-story building titled 'Hôtel zur Krone,' with a shop on the ground level, situated on a tree-lined street. The central text reads 'Gruss aus Bad Pyrmont.' The reverse bears the word 'Postkarte' in Fraktur script, a large stylized 'M' likely for the publisher, and blank lines for address and message.
